note.zh: 选择破解终端后，本阶段要么突破得到“公式”（125），要么在某次掷骰时以每次 1.5% 的基础概率失败，科学家被封入泡沫材料（120）。
note.en: After choosing to hack the terminal the stage either breaks through to “A Formula” (125) or fails on a roll (base 1.5% per roll) and the scientist is entombed (120).

note.zh: 探索结束，获得“程序空间”修正。
note.en: The exploration ends with the Procedural Space modifier.

note.zh: 探索结束，获得大量星界丝缕。
note.en: The exploration ends with a large astral thread reward.

note.zh: 失败分支 120 中科学家被放逐、探索结束；1800 天后科学家归来，获得材料或粒子专长及“裂隙扭曲”特质。
note.en: In failure branch 120 the scientist is exiled and the exploration ends; 1800 days later the scientist returns with a Materials or Particles expertise and the Rift Warped trait.

scope.zh: 已核对裂隙定义与 100–140 全部事件，补上 115.a 的失败分支 120（原为独立故事）及其 1800 天后的归来事件。
scope.en: Checked the rift definition and every event 100–140; added the failure branch 120 of 115.a (formerly a separate story) and its 1800-day return event.
